name: hud
description: A heads-up display under or above the prompt: model, branch, context and plan limits, and memory headroom. /hud opens the full view

band.title: Band
band.description: What the band above the prompt shows: panel (two rows with bars), line (one compact row) or off. Use off with the status line script, which draws the panel under the prompt

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: While a turn runs, show the latest note another mod added to a tool result. Claude Code already shows the tool, its errors, the subagents and the time

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Show how much memory still fits before the tightest cgroup limit, or the machine's when there is none

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the times shown and for what counts as today, such as America/New_York. Empty uses the system time zone.

bar.title: Bar style
bar.description: Glyphs of the bars: dots (●○, the default), blocks (▰▱), solid (█░), line (━─) or squares (■□)

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: Cells of a full-width bar, 4 to 30. Narrow terminals still shrink the bars

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Colors for ok, warning and critical, separated by spaces: names (green, bright-cyan), #rrggbb or 0-255. Empty uses green, yellow and red

hide.title: Hidden fields
hide.description: Fields to leave out, separated by commas: model, project, branch, age, calls, ctx, 5h, 7d, reset, mem

contextBase.title: Context measured against
contextBase.description: compact: 100% is the auto-compact window (/autocompact), when it is smaller than the model's window. window: the model's full window

style.title: Status line style
style.description: Layout of the status line under the prompt: refined (two rows, the default), blocks (two rows of colored blocks), minimal (two rows in words) or compact (one row, two when it does not fit)

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd uses Nerd Font glyphs for git, folder, model and memory, which need a Nerd Font in the terminal. unicode uses plain arrows and marks

barColor.title: Bar colors
barColor.description: gradient gives each bar cell the color of its place, green to red (the default). solid paints the whole bar one color that slides from green to red with the percent. tone keeps the three threshold colors of the colors option
